title: Perfect app
body: No hidden payments or subscriptions, simple and minimalistic, works wonderfully as an everyday habit tracker or as a daily to do list
author: Rqelchel

title: Exactly what you need
body: So easy to use, free, no ads & does exactly what you need. Set your own habits, use your own emojis and tick when done that day. Couldn’t be easier.
author: bethmawds__

title: Love
body: I love this app so much it’s the first app I’ve seen that is completely free , easy to use and can track so many of my habits I use this daily and I’m so grateful for it. My ONLY suggestion / criticism would be to add different sections for different habits. So we can create our own sections and organise habits better. I’m also wondering if we can view habit consistency from previous years I noticed it only shows 2026 so I’m a bit nervous for when we go into the new year I hope all of my 2026 is not removed but time will tell! Other than that I geniunly love this app so much
author: qlishq

title: Great app
body: App is easy to use and simple. I think needs a bit more character and bit more of celebration for those who like dopamine hits due to neurodivergent
author: Amiee Steel

title: i love this app
body: i came across the video on tiktok and i’m so grateful that this is free and it’s so minimal and cute!!
